title: Mebetoys
summary: 300px|rightMeccanica Besana Toys, shortened to Mebetoys, was an Italian toy manufacturer. Founded in 1959 by the Besana brothers, Ugo and Martino, in Novara, Italy, Mebetoys started out making key chains, toy guns and toy irons and ironing boards. Their father, Giovanni, gave the company its name.

title: Hot Wheels Model Car Kits
summary: A Model Car Kit is a toy car, usually in 1:32, 1:25 & 1:24 scale that needs to be assembled, glued, painted, and put together to have a finished custom car.
